scope: CPU audit only; no sample code execution, teacher API, GPU, train/val selection or training export.

method.clean_policy: Remove assistant reasoning_content/reason_content and one balanced leading think block; quarantine malformed/nonleading/multiple blocks. Preserve visible explanation, tool calls, observations and all roles.
method.tool_normalization: Decode documented JSON-string function arguments/parameters, retaining their original fields/actions.
method.supervision_proxy: Assistant content bodies only, excludes thought fields, wrappers and tool call serialization. NOT final ms-swift labels; no train windows/packing defined.
method.processed_proxy: One complete rendered sequence, before training repetition/window duplication/padding. NOT final training cost.
method.short_answer_proxy: <=128 clean assistant-content tokens per record is only a formal shortness flag, not proof of final-answer-only or correctness.

selection.method: 128 uniform random row indices within first shard only; NOT a random sample of the full dataset
